newsitem.title: CHINA: China says mulling signing rights covenants.
newsitem.headline: China says mulling signing rights covenants.

text.p: China said on Thursday it was considering signing two international covenants on human rights, a Foreign Ministry spokesman said on Thursday.
"We are actively considering this," Tang Guoqiang said when asked if China would sign the two covenants, but he said it was at Beijing's discretion when to join.
He also urged the United States to stop what he described as the "erroneous" policy of using human rights to interfere in China's internal affairs.
The New York Times reported this week that China would agree to sign the two key international covenants on human rights as part of a deal with the United States.
U.S. officials have said they do not believe a deal is imminent.
U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright visited China this week for her first talks with Chinese leaders, but reported no concrete progress on human rights or breakthroughs on other issues.
